sets.relationshipLabel: kitchen tool and the action it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A whisk exists to beat and a grater exists to shred — each tool is defined by the single motion it's built for.

sets.relationshipLabel: informal household term becomes the formal/specific appliance name
sets.explanation: You call it a fridge, but its formal name is refrigerator; you call it a freezer, but the standalone unit is a deep freezer — each pair moves from everyday speech to the precise term.

sets.relationshipLabel: fixture fastened to shield or complete the surface it's mounted to
sets.explanation: A backsplash is fastened to protect the wall behind it, and a toe-kick is fastened to finish off the cabinet base beneath it — each fixture exists to cover what it's attached to.

sets.relationshipLabel: same kind of cookware, smaller then larger
sets.explanation: A saucepan scales up to a stockpot and a ramekin scales up to a roasting pan — same category of vessel, just sized differently.

glossary.definition: A short recessed strip of trim near the floor, set back so you can stand close without stubbing your toes.
